Card Q&A.q: Do I have to activate this card's [End of Your Turn] effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your opponent's Digimon doesn't unsuspend.
[When Attacking] By suspending 1 of your other Digimon, unsuspend this Digimon.
[End of Your Turn] Trash the top card of this Digimon and unsuspend all of your Digimon.
